newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-BARCELONA CALL UP FOURTH-CHOICE GOALKEEPER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BARCELONA CALL UP FOURTH-CHOICE GOALKEEPER.

text.p: Barcelona could be relying on fourth-choice goalkeeper Francesc Arnau for Saturday's Spanish league clash against Atletico Madrid after Carlos Busquets went down with a fever on Friday.
Busquets had been expected to stand in for regular first team goalkeeper Vitor Baia, who is away on international duty. Second reserve Julen Lopetegui is out with a finger injury.
Arnau plays in the second division for Barcelona's reserve team.

But there was some good news for manager Bobby Robson's injury-hit squad. The Spanish league surprisingly decided to overrule an automatic suspension on defender Miguel Angel Nadal, who was sent off last Monday at Sporting Gijon.
